subject.title: [Bug]: Empty assistant delivery (footer-only, "— out" usage) on first turn after /new on Telegram-routed topic lane — 2026.5.27

question: Should this umbrella remain the canonical reset/session-state reliability issue, or should maintainers split it into reset atomicity, inbound self-heal, Telegram UX, and telemetry/schema issues before repair?
rationale: Current source supports a real remaining reset invariant, but the issue also includes feature-like diagnostics and multiple related open bugs that need owner scoping before automation can safely act.

options.title: Split and keep canonical
options.body: Keep this issue open as the umbrella, create or nominate focused child issues for reset atomicity and self-heal first, and defer telemetry/UX choices to maintainers.

options.title: Narrow to reset atomicity only
options.body: Retitle/scope this issue to the store-before-transcript durability invariant and move Telegram UX and telemetry requests elsewhere.

options.title: Wait for live repro
options.body: Leave labels as-is and require fresh live Telegram proof before any implementation work is authorized.

recommendation.title: Split and keep canonical
recommendation.body: Keep this issue open as the umbrella, create or nominate focused child issues for reset atomicity and self-heal first, and defer telemetry/UX choices to maintainers.

likelyOwner.reason: The remaining choice spans session storage, gateway reset ownership, and pluginized channel boundaries where Peter has broad recent history.
